name: airflac
description: Lossless audio conversion for broadcast. Self-hosted WAV/lossy to FLAC converter for radio stations.
author: Tyler Woodward

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @airflac/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @airflac/shared && npm run build -w @airflac/server && npm run build -w @airflac/client
